title: Build Your Profile Page
prompt: Build your personal profile page from the project brief: complete document, header with one <h1> (your name), nav with fragment links, main with About / Hobbies / Gallery / Contact sections, labeled email form, and a footer. Content is yours — structure is graded.

tests.name: complete document skeleton
tests.hint: Same skeleton as your first page: doctype, html lang, head (charset + title), body.

tests.name: header with exactly one h1
tests.hint: <header> opens the page; your name is the one <h1>.

tests.name: nav with fragment links
tests.hint: Each nav link points at an id on the page: <a href="#about"> needs id="about" somewhere.

tests.name: main with About, Hobbies, Gallery sections
tests.hint: Three sections with h2 headings and ids: about, hobbies, gallery.

tests.name: image with meaningful alt
tests.hint: alt describes the picture's content — what would a visitor miss if it did not load?

tests.name: contact form with labeled email
tests.hint: From the forms lesson: input type=email + id, <label for>, button type=submit.

tests.name: footer and clean heading levels
tests.hint: The outline rule: each heading steps down at most one level from the one before.
